title: Information Sciences and Technology for Mathematics, Minor (Eberly College of Science)
notes: 18cr exact bulletin match. Bulletin's own listed plan code is ISMTH_UMNR; minor code ISMTHMIN mirrors that abbreviation while avoiding collision with the already-built plain IST minor (ISTMIN). Prescribed Courses (9cr): IST 110 + IST 210 + IST 220, all three prereq- and concurrent-free per ist_catalog.json. Additional Courses -- 'select three of the following 400-level mathematics courses' from {MATH 451, MATH 457, MATH 465, MATH 467, MATH 468} -- filled with MATH 457 (3cr, prereq-free) + MATH 467 (3cr, needs CMPSC 360 OR MATH 311W) + MATH 451 (3cr, needs a CMPSC intro-programming course AND [MATH 230 or MATH 231]). First draft used MATH 465/468 instead of MATH 467/451 and initially looked like a clean single hidden addition (both need only MATH 311W) -- but a live build against CMPSC surfaced a real 'could not schedule MATH 465, MATH 468, MATH 311W' warning: math_catalog.json's own MATH 311W record notes 'students who have passed CMPSC 360 may not schedule this course for credit', and CMPSC's own required flowchart already includes CMPSC 360, so adding MATH 311W directly conflicts with a real catalog-level anti-requisite already required by the baseline major -- the same class of bug documented for MATHMIN's MATH 230/232 exclusion in an earlier batch. Fixed by swapping to MATH 467, whose own prereq is the OR-alternative {CMPSC 360, MATH 311W} -- CMPSC's own required CMPSC 360 satisfies it directly with zero net-new courses -- and MATH 451, whose second branch needs MATH 230 or MATH 231; picked MATH 230 specifically (not MATH 231) since MATH 230 and MATH 231 are themselves a real mutual anti-requisite pair (per MATH 230's own course description; MATH 232's excludes field independently confirms the same family conflicts with MATH 230) and MATH 230 is the exact course the already-built Mathematics major itself requires, avoiding any risk of a second undetected exclusion. Real hidden-prereq addition for the CMPSC pairing: MATH 230 (4cr, needs only MATH 141, already required by CMPSC's own flowchart) -- MATH 467's own prereq is satisfied for free by CMPSC's existing CMPSC 360 requirement, and MATH 451's first branch is satisfied for free by CMPSC's existing intro-programming pool -- computed total against CMPSC = 18 + 4 = 22cr. Also verified against the already-built Mathematics major (MATH), which already independently requires MATH 230, MATH 311W, and an intro-programming course on its own flowchart (a true no-op for all three prereq branches) -- only the three IST courses (9cr) are net-new there, giving the MATH pairing its full real-world value.
